contacts.notesPh: Notes (rates, hours, what to send them…)
contacts.scopeNote: With no property selected, the contact applies to all (e.g. the accountant). This data stays in your app, behind your password.
contacts.noneSearch: No contacts for this search. Add your accountant, insurer, contractors…
contacts.none: No contacts. Add your accountant, insurer, contractors…
contacts.pageIntro: Accountant, insurer, contractors, cleaners… with their details, the properties concerned and your exchange history.

domo.noConnector: No connector on this place in Loussa Places.
domo.readOnly: Read-only: discovery does not control or change anything.
domo.connectFirst: Connect your Homey first (Settings tab) to discover this property's devices, including those on the Aqara hub.
domo.clickDiscover: Click “Run discovery” to list devices (heating, sensors, sockets, scenes…) with their current state. Then pick the ones that belong to this property.
domo.noneSeen: Connection successful, but Homey sees no devices with these access rights.
domo.prepDesc: Nothing is sent to Homey: settings are saved and the rule is only simulated on upcoming bookings.
domo.urlFromCloud: The address is provided by the Homey cloud.
domo.step1: {n} Enter your Homey app's client ID and secret in {link} (Smart home). Never paste them in the chat.
domo.step2: {n} In Homey's developer tools, register this callback address: {uri}
domo.appDetected: App detected. The callback address registered with Homey must be exactly: {uri}
domo.accountConnected: Homey account connected on {date} (the token stays on the server).
domo.keyMissing: API key missing: create it in Homey (Settings → API keys, minimum rights: read and control devices), then paste it in {link} (Smart home). Never paste it in the chat.
domo.pickWarn: Choose this property's Homey, then save: without a link, no device is read or controlled.
domo.testNote: Only checks access: reads no device, controls nothing. Save the settings first.
domo.simOff: Turn the rule on to see what it would do on upcoming bookings. Check-in and check-out times are read from Lodgify (Paris time); no preheating without a booking.
domo.noAction: No action planned: no upcoming bookings on this property.
domo.oauthRefused: Authorisation refused or cancelled: the account is not connected.
domo.oauthState: Invalid authorisation callback (session expired?). Start the connection again.
domo.oauthError: Homey account connection failed. Check the client ID, the secret and the registered callback address, then try again.
domo.confirmDisconnect: Disconnect the Homey account? The token stored on the server will be erased.
domo.validConnCount: Connection valid ({n} device seen) | Connection valid ({n} devices seen)

locks.noLock: No lock linked to this property (see Settings).
locks.codesNote: Keypad codes: each opens 1 h before check-in and closes 1 h after check-out (Lodgify times, Paris time). Nothing is sent to Nuki before you click.
locks.outdated: ⚠ Dates changed since creation: redo it manually in Nuki.
locks.noBooking: No upcoming bookings on this lock.

qr.intro: Print it and stick it in the property (cupboard, cleaning room). The cleaner scans it to report stock levels, no account needed.
qr.confirm: Generate a new link for {name}? The currently printed QR code will stop working.

docs.intro: All the property's files. Right-click a file → “Type and amount…”: an accounting type (invoice, tax, insurance…) with its date and amount counts it in the Balance. The “Type” filter on the right finds accounting files.
docs.pageIntro: One folder per property, with as many subfolders as you like. The same folders are available from each property's page (Files tab).

mails.intro: Emails linked to this property’s bookings or contacts (contacts shared by all properties are not included).
mails.none: No emails linked to this property.
